descriptionByLocale.en:
• Are you a people person? Do you know how to spread your enthusiasm about the markets to others? We are looking for someone who can
• •grow our successful India equity business in the US and, further strengthen the cross border coverage for our global clients and enhance coverage of our local clients in India
• •provide unparalleled global (leveraging our platform) and local (on the ground) insights to help clients with their investment decision process
• •originate, develop and maintain client relationships by understanding their specific needs, which may include goals and objectives, risk tolerance and expectations
• •help organize bespoke events and also ensure active client participation in the same
• •stay on top of market developments, regulatory changes and new product offerings
• •integrate understanding of markets, events and research views into actionable recommendations for clients to help generate alpha
• •collaborate with clients, research analysts, traders and other salespeople
